title: ceratoides lenensis
intro: Ceratoides lenensis, commonly known as Rock Tansy, is a perennial plant that belongs to the family Brassicaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of Ceratoides lenensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
